p:cNvPr.descr: An image depicting the opposing pathways of glycolysis and gluconeogenesis in rat liver. On the left and in pink is an arrow pointing down, representing glycolysis. On the right and in blue is an arrow pointing up, representing gluconeogenesis. Glucose in a box is in the middle at the top. Reversible arrows are through this image, with a red one on the left pointing down, and a blue one on the right pointing up. From glucose, a red arrow points down on the left to glucose 6-phosphate, which has a blue arrow pointing up back to glucose. To the left of the red arrow is a red curved arrow pointing down from ATP to ADP. In the middle of the arc is hexokinase in red. To the right of the blue arrow is a blue curved arrow pointing up from H2O to Pi. In the middle of the arc is glucose 6-phosphatase in blue. Below glucose 6-phosphate are reversible arrows pointing to fructose 6-phosphate. To the left is a red arrow pointing down to fructose 1.6-bisphosphate, with a blue arrow on the right pointing back up. To the left of the red arrow is a red curved arrow pointing down from ATP to ADP. In the middle of the arc is phosphofructokinase-1 in red. To the right of the blue arrow is a blue curved arrow pointing up from H2O to Pi. In the middle of the arc is fructose 1,6-bisphosphatase-1 in blue. Below fructose 1,6-bisphosphate are reversible arrows pointing to (2) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate. The red down arrow has another arrow jetting left to dihydroxyacetone phosphate, which has reversible arrows pointing to (2) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate. To the right of the blue arrow pointing up, dihydroxyacetone phosphate joins this arrow. Reversible arrows point from this to (2) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate. Below (2) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate are reversible arrows pointing to (2) 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate. On the left 2Pi joins the red down arrow. There is also a red curved arrow pointing from 2NAD+ down to SNADH [plus] 2H+. To the right, another blue arrow jetting right points to 2Pi. There is also a blue curved arrow pointing up from 2NADH [plus] 2H+ to SNAD+. Below (2) 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate are reversible arrows. On the left is a red curved arrow pointing from 2ADP down to 2ATP. On the right is a blue curved arrow pointing from 2ATP up to 2ADP. The reversible arrows point to (2) 3-phosphoglycerate. Below this are reversible arrows pointing to (2) 2-phosphoglycerate. Below this are reversible arrows pointing down to (2) phosphoenolpyruvate. To the left is a curved red arrow down to (2) pyruvate in a tan box. To the left of this arrow is a red curved arrow pointing from 2ADP down to 2ATP. In the middle of the arc is pyruvate kinase in red. On the right, a curved blue arrow points up from (2) pyruvate to (2) oxaloacetate. To the right of this arrow is a curved arrow pointing from 2ATP up to 2ADP. From (2) oxaloacetate is a blue curved arrow pointing back up to (2) phosphoenolpyruvate. To the right of this arrow is a blue curved arrow pointing from 2GTP up to 2GDP. In the middle of the arc is PEP caboxykinase in blue.
